land after the contributed map in the generated Load call) and draws a

package web

import "context"

//fabrik:templates:func name=asset
func CustomAsset(path string) string { return "/custom/" + path }

//fabrik:templates:global name=importmap
func CustomImportmap(ctx context.Context) string { return "" }

-- web/web.go --
package web

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/templates"
)

type Handlers struct {
	Templates *templates.Set
}

//fabrik:http GET /{$}
func (h *Handlers) Home(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	h.Templates.Render(r.Context(), w, "home", nil)
}
-- want/main.gen.go --
// Code generated by fabrik. DO NOT EDIT.
// Regenerate with: fabrik wire

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/assetmapper"
	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router"
	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/templates"

	"app/web"
)

func run() int {
	if err := func() (err error) {
		// Providers
		assetCompiled, err := assetmapper.Build([]assetmapper.Root{
			{FS: web.Assets, Dir: "assets"},
		}, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		webTemplates, err := templates.Load(web.Templates, "templates", templates.Funcs(assetCompiled.FuncMap()), templates.Funcs(templates.FuncMap{
			"asset": web.CustomAsset,
		}), templates.Globals(func(b *templates.Binding) templates.FuncMap {
			return templates.FuncMap{
				"importmap": func() string { return web.CustomImportmap(b.Ctx()) },
			}
		}))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		webHandlers := &web.Handlers{
			Templates: webTemplates,
		}

		r := router.New()

		// Register
		r.Handle("/assets/", assetCompiled.Handler())
		r.Method("GET", "/{$}", webHandlers.Home)
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "app:", err)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
